camera_collision.label: Third-person camera collision

stop.label: Stop
stop.description: Stops the camera control just short of the collision.

climb.label: Climb over
climb.description: Rises over what blocks it; stops where the way up is blocked too.

camera_collision.description: What the third-person camera does when terrain or an object blocks it. First person has none.

shadows.label: Shadows
shadows.description: The sun casts shadows from the terrain, objects and characters onto the ground.

center_support.label: Center support
center_support.description: The map center moves along what supports it. Off, it keeps its height and passes through terrain and objects.
